amine_200_arm_count._what_this_proves: Within a homologous series holding the amine fixed and walking the tail length, dC/d(tail) EQUALS the number of arms. KW_2014's A200_C10..C14 gives 5 arms on a 5-nitrogen core; KL_2010's 200C8..C14 gives 1 arm on a 3-nitrogen core. Both series are INTERNALLY self-consistent, which is precisely why F-061 is a real conflict and not a typo: two curations each coherently encode a different molecule for the same catalogue amine. Reported; data/ untouched.

DOPC.byte_identity_note: Byte identity is EXPECTED and is NOT the signal (F-037): a correct re-derivation canonicalises to the same string as a correct stored structure. What matters is that the build ROUTE shares nothing with the registry, which make_reference.ast_guard tests at run time on its own AST.

three_way_helper_concordance._independence_posture: This is a NAME-CONCORDANCE check, NOT an external attestation of this paper's chemistry. The paper draws no structure; it prints a systematic name, and all three legs of this comparison are derivations from that same name by different hands. It catches a transcription error in any leg -- and the briefing records a sibling whose hand-built DSPC came out a ketone bearing an ether at the right mass to six decimals -- but it cannot catch a name that is wrong FOR THIS PAPER. Counted as such in PROVENANCE.md and NOT counted as a C10 pass.
